Problem Statement
Given an age value, validate it. If the age is negative, explicitly throw an exception and handle it; otherwise, confirm that the age is valid.
Description
Read an integer age. Check if age is negative; if so, explicitly throw an IllegalArgumentException with the message "Invalid age". Catch this exception and print an error message using the exception's message. If age is not negative, print that the age is valid.
Input Description
A single line containing an integer, age.
Output Description
If age is zero or positive, print "Valid age: " followed by the value. If age is negative, print "Error: Invalid age".
Sample Input
25
Sample Output
Valid age: 25
